t: A Godot 4 game engine that builds games from plain language prompts.
steps: Find the Summer Engine site and read the privacy policy.
Note that the policy says the product is intended for users 18 and older.
Ask the vendor for written agreement before school use.
Ask IT to approve the desktop app.
Install the app on one machine.
Log in only if you use the hosted AI.
Review the credit prices in the vendor docs.
